fr.title: Alabama State University - Admissions (freshman requirements, test-optional policy, deadlines, fee)

intl.title: Alabama State University - International Student Admissions

chk.title: Alabama State University - International Student Checklist

test_policy.notes: The freshman admissions page says ASU is test-optional, but ACT/SAT scores still decide which admission tier applies (sliding GPA/test scale; applicants with a 2.4+ GPA and no score fall in Tier II). The international page lists ACT or SAT among its required documents with its own GPA/score table (for example GPA 3.50+ with SAT 720 or ACT 15), so international applicants should confirm whether scores are needed.

requirements.notes: Apply with ASU's own online application; the Common App is not mentioned. $30 application fee on both the freshman and international pages. International applicants also send transcripts evaluated by Lisano International, WES or another NACES member, a notarized Confidential Financial Support Affidavit covering first-year expenses, a health evaluation with TB results, and proof of health insurance with repatriation and medical evacuation cover. The Form I-20 is issued only after all requirements are met.

deadlines.label: International application deadline, fall 2027
deadlines.notes: International page: fall (begins August) June 1, spring November 1, summer April 1; the checklist repeats these dates. The pages give no year, so fall 2027 is assumed. The freshman page lists a July 30 fall deadline for domestic applicants.

deadlines.label: Academic scholarship application (applications open October 1)
deadlines.notes: Freshman page: scholarship applications open October 1 and are accepted through February 15; the page prints no year, so the 2026-27 cycle is assumed. The international page says international students are eligible for academic scholarships.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Students from English-speaking countries (the page names the UK, Canada except Quebec, and Nigeria) and applicants who completed a degree at a regionally accredited U.S. institution are exempt. The requirement is also met by completing Level 112 at a Language Center (as printed).

english.notes: Regular admission: 70 iBT (525 paper, 193 computer). Conditional admission is offered at 69 iBT (523-477 paper, 190 computer) as printed. The same page's application-process section lists lower minimums (61 iBT / 500 paper / 173 computer), so the two passages conflict; 70 is the figure shown, as the safer one. No 1-6 band value is given.

aid.notes: International page: international students are 'eligible for academic scholarships and assistantships but not for financial aid' and pay out-of-state tuition. The scholarship page lists Marion 9 Automatic Scholarships and Competitive Merit Scholarships but prints no amounts or criteria, so none are given here.

sat.note: No SAT code is printed on the pages read.

act.note: No ACT code is printed on the pages read.

toefl.note: No TOEFL institution code is printed on the pages read.
